verdict.rationale: The RTX 5080 product page lists NVIDIA Project G-Assist, an AI assistant that 'helps you tune, control, and optimize your system,' which is a first-party way to operate the GPU and PC through an assistant. The evidence is one marketing line, the 'Project' label suggests an early-stage feature, and it never explicitly says commands are given in natural language. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language command input, the scope of GPU settings it can control, maturity or availability status, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: NVIDIA Project G-Assist is an AI assistant powered by your GeForce RTX PC that helps you tune, control, and optimize your system.
